cases.cypher: MATCH (f:File) RETURN f.relativePath AS path, f.language AS language, f.isTest AS isTest
MATCH (n:Function) RETURN count(n) AS count
MATCH (n:Call) RETURN count(*) AS count
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn, c.name AS call, c.line AS line
MATCH (f:File), (r:Repo) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, r.name AS repo
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function), (f)-[:IMPORTS]->(i:Import) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn, i.source AS source
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) MATCH (fn)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) RETURN fn.name AS fn, count(c) AS calls
MATCH (fn:Function {isExported: true}) RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.line AS line
MATCH (r:Route {method: 'GET'}) RETURN r.path AS path, r.framework AS framework
MATCH (f:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(:Import)-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(t:File) RETURN f.relativePath AS source, t.relativePath AS target
MATCH (f:File)-->(x:Import) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, x.source AS source
MATCH (x)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) RETURN x.name AS caller, c.name AS callee
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(v) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, v.name AS name, v.kind AS kind
MATCH (a)-[:ROUTE_HANDLED_BY]->(b) RETURN a.path AS path, b.name AS handler
MATCH (fn:Function)<-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]-(f:File) RETURN fn.name AS fn, f.relativePath AS file
MATCH (fn:Function)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]-(f:File) RETURN fn.name AS fn, f.relativePath AS file
MATCH (f:File)-[r:DEFINES_FUNCTION|DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(x) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, x.name AS name
MATCH (r:Route)-[s:ROUTE_LIFECYCLE_STEP]->(fn:Function) RETURN r.path AS path, fn.name AS fn, s.role AS role, s.scope AS scope, s.hook AS hook, s.orderIndex AS orderIndex
MATCH (r:Route)-[s:ROUTE_LIFECYCLE_STEP {role: 'middleware'}]->(fn:Function) RETURN r.path AS path, fn.name AS fn
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(a:Function), (f)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(b:Function) RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b
MATCH (a:File)-[r1:CONTAINS_FILE]-(d:Directory)-[r2:CONTAINS_FILE]-(b:File) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (c:Class)-[:EXTENDS]->(p:Class)<-[:EXTENDS]-(s:Class) RETURN c.name AS c, p.name AS p, s.name AS s
MATCH (r:Repo)-[:HAS_PACKAGE]->(p:Package)-[:PACKAGE_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:File) RETURN p.name AS package, p.relativePath AS packagePath, f.relativePath AS file
MATCH (f:File)-[r:DECLARES_CONFIG_FILE]->(c:ConfigValue) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, c.name AS name, c.value AS value, c.valueType AS valueType
MATCH (fn:Function)-[r:ACCESSES_DATA_FUNCTION]->(m:DataModel) RETURN fn.name AS fn, m.name AS model, r.operation AS operation, r.library AS library, r.line AS line
MATCH (a:Variable)-[m:MOUNTS_VARIABLE]->(b:Variable) RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b, m.path AS path, m.pathExpression AS pathExpression, m.line AS line
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*1..3]->(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*2..2]->(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*]->(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*..2]->(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (r:Repo)-[:CONTAINS_ROOT]->(d:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*0..5]->(x:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:File) RETURN r.name AS repo, x.relativePath AS dir, f.relativePath AS file
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*0..1]->(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (b:Directory)<-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*1..3]-(a:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*1..2]-(b:Directory) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (c:Class)-[:EXTENDS*1..5]->(p:Class) RETURN c.name AS c, p.name AS p
MATCH (a:Function)-[:CALLS]->(:Call)-[:CALL_RESOLVES_TO]->(b:Function) RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b
MATCH (a:File)-[:IMPORTS|RESOLVES_TO*2..4]->(b:File) RETURN a.relativePath AS a, b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*1..3]->(b:Directory) RETURN count(*) AS paths
MATCH (a:Directory)-[:CONTAINS_DIRECTORY*1..3]->(b:Directory) RETURN DISTINCT b.relativePath AS b
MATCH (r:Repo)-[*1..2]->(x:Directory) RETURN r.name AS repo, x.relativePath AS dir
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(r:Route) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, r.path AS route
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(r:Route) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, count(r) AS routes
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(r:Route) WHERE r.method = 'GET' RETURN f.relativePath AS file, r.path AS route
MATCH (f:File)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(r:Route) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:ROUTE_HANDLED_BY]->(h:Function) WHERE r.method = 'POST' RETURN r.path AS path, r.method AS method, h.name AS handler
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) WHERE false RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn
MATCH (r:Route) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:ROUTE_HANDLED_BY]->(h:Function)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) RETURN r.path AS path, h.name AS handler, c.name AS call
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(c:Class) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn, c.name AS cls
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Route) RETURN r.path AS path
MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(r:Route) MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(v:Variable) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, r.path AS route, v.name AS variable
MATCH (fn:Function) OPTIONAL MATCH (fn)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) WITH fn, c WHERE c IS NULL RETURN fn.name AS fn
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name = 'listUsers' RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.line AS line
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name <> 'listUsers' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (c:Call) WHERE c.line >= 5 AND c.line < 20 RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.isExported = false RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.isAsync RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE NOT fn.isExported RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.isAsync OR fn.isExported RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.isAsync XOR fn.isExported RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.isAsync OR fn.isExported AND fn.line > 3 RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE (fn.isAsync OR fn.isExported) AND fn.line > 3 RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name CONTAINS 'User' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE contains(lower(fn.name), 'user') RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.relativePath STARTS WITH 'src' RETURN f.relativePath AS path
MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.relativePath ENDS WITH '.ts' RETURN f.relativePath AS path
MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.method IN ['GET', 'DELETE'] RETURN r.method AS method, r.path AS path
MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.method IN [] RETURN r.path AS path
MATCH (r:Route) WHERE NOT r.method IN ['GET'] RETURN r.method AS method, r.path AS path
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.className IS NULL RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.className IS NOT NULL RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.className AS className
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.className = NULL RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.className = 'X' OR true RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE NOT (fn.className = 'nope') RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name > 'm' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name = 'LISTUSERS' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE toLower(fn.name) = 'listusers' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE upper(fn.name) STARTS WITH 'LIST' RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (fn:Function)-[:CALLS]->(c:Call) WHERE c.line > fn.line RETURN fn.name AS fn, c.name AS call
MATCH (f:File) MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) WHERE fn.isExported = true AND f.relativePath ENDS WITH '.ts' RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.endLine - fn.line >= 2 RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.endLine - fn.line AS span
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name = $name RETURN fn.name AS name
MATCH (c:Call) WHERE c.line > $line RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line
MATCH (r:Route) RETURN $kind AS kind, r.path AS path
RETURN 1 AS one, 'two' AS two, true AS yes, NULL AS nothing, 1.5 AS half
RETURN 7 / 2 AS div, 7 % 3 AS mod, 2 + 3 * 4 AS expr, -5 AS neg, 7.0 / 2 AS fdiv
MATCH (r:Route) RETURN r.method + ' ' + r.path AS route
RETURN [1, 2, 3] AS list, size([1, 2]) AS n
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, lower(fn.name) AS lower, upper(fn.name) AS upper, size(fn.name) AS length
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, coalesce(fn.className, 'none') AS cls
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, CASE WHEN fn.isExported = true THEN 'public' ELSE 'private' END AS visibility

cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Route) RETURN r.path AS path, CASE r.method WHEN 'GET' THEN 'read' WHEN 'POST' THEN 'write' ELSE 'other' END AS kind
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE|DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(x) RETURN x.name AS name, label(x) AS label
MATCH (s:Route)-[step:ROUTE_LIFECYCLE_STEP]->(fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS fn, step.hook AS hook
MATCH (r:Route) RETURN DISTINCT r.method AS method
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN DISTINCT f.relativePath AS file, fn.isExported AS exported
MATCH (r:Route) RETURN r.path, r.method
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE|DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(x) RETURN x.name AS name, x.kind AS kind
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, count(fn) AS functions
MATCH (r:Route) RETURN count(DISTINCT r.method) AS methods, count(r.method) AS total
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN count(fn.className) AS withClass, count(*) AS total
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN min(c.line) AS first, max(c.line) AS last
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN min(fn.name) AS first, max(fn.name) AS last
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN sum(c.line) AS total, avg(c.line) AS mean
MATCH (r:Route) WITH r ORDER BY r.path, r.method LIMIT 100 RETURN collect(r.path) AS paths
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, size(collect(fn.name)) AS n
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN size(collect(fn.className)) AS n
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name = 'no-such-function' RETURN count(fn) AS count, min(fn.line) AS first, collect(fn.name) AS names
MATCH (fn:Function) WHERE fn.name = 'no-such-function' RETURN fn.name AS name, count(*) AS count
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN max(c.line) - min(c.line) AS span
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(v:Variable) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, count(v) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, file
MATCH (fn:Function) WITH fn.name AS name, fn.line AS line RETURN name, line
MATCH (source:File)-[rel:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) WITH source AS file, source, fn RETURN file.relativePath AS file, source.relativePath AS source, fn.name AS fn
MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) WITH f, count(fn) AS n WHERE n > 1 RETURN f.relativePath AS file, n
MATCH (r:Route) WITH DISTINCT r.method AS method RETURN method
MATCH (c:Call) WITH c ORDER BY c.line DESC, c.name LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line
MATCH (fn:Function) WITH fn WHERE fn.isExported = true WITH fn.name AS name RETURN name
MATCH (f:File) WITH f WHERE f.relativePath ENDS WITH '.ts' MATCH (f)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN f.relativePath AS file, fn.name AS fn
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line, c.columnNumber AS col ORDER BY c.line, c.columnNumber, c.name
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line, c.columnNumber AS col ORDER BY c.line DESC, c.columnNumber DESC, c.name DESC
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.className AS cls ORDER BY cls, name
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.className AS cls ORDER BY cls DESC, name
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name, fn.isExported AS e ORDER BY e, name
MATCH (x) WHERE x.name IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT x.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN c.name AS name, c.line AS line, c.columnNumber AS col ORDER BY c.line, c.columnNumber, c.name SKIP 2 LIMIT 3
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN c.name AS name LIMIT 0
MATCH (c:Call) RETURN c.name AS name ORDER BY name SKIP 1000
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name ORDER BY size(fn.name) DESC, fn.name
MATCH (fn:Function) RETURN fn.name AS name ORDER BY fn.line, fn.name
match (f:File) where f.relativePath ends with '.ts' return f.relativePath as path order by path
MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.method = "GET" RETURN r.path AS path

MATCH (x:NoSuchLabel) RETURN x.name AS name
MATCH (a:File)-[:NO_SUCH_REL]->(b) RETURN a.relativePath AS a
MATCH (f:File) RETURN f.noSuchProperty AS x
